motion.name: example hairline
motion.purpose: One left-to-right draw points to the illustrative call. The text stays visible; reduced motion shows a static line.

motion.name: link arrow
motion.purpose: Small horizontal shift on link hover and focus; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: primary hover
motion.purpose: Darken the primary action on hover; disabled for reduced motion.

display.purpose: Two-line promise in the first viewport.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: The dark pill link to the local documentation.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: .6em 1.5em; border-radius: 100px; background: #171717; color: #fff; font: 500 18px Geist, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #303030; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #171717; outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text action
components.description: Plain text with a small arrow; underline and shift appear on interaction.
components.css: .ds-text-action { color: #171717; font: 400 18px Geist, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-text-action span { display: inline-block; margin-left: 4px; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-text-action:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 5px; } .ds-text-action:hover span, .ds-text-action:focus-visible span { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #171717; outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-text-action span { transition: none; } }

components.name: Illustrative assessment
components.description: An unframed example of the observed tool call and opt-in qualifier.
components.html:
Example tool call

Rule: Never publish code without approval

Call: git push origin main

Observe: TENET flags the call. It still runs.

Enforcement is opt-in.
components.css: .ds-assessment { position: relative; padding-top: 23px; color: #171717; font: 400 18px/1.5 Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-assessment::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; border-top: 1px solid #cacdd0; transform-origin: left center; } .ds-assessment small, .ds-assessment aside { color: #6b7077; font-size: 14px; } .ds-assessment p { margin: 8px 0 0; } .ds-assessment aside { margin-top: 24px; } @keyframes ds-assessment-rule-in { from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: scaleX(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-assessment::before { animation: ds-assessment-rule-in 560ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; } }

narrative.overview: A white field, near-black type, measured hairlines, and one concrete assessment do the work. The approved split composition gives the promise and action room to breathe; the example is evidence, not a dashboard or decorative object. Keep the claims as restrained as the page.
keyCharacteristics: White field, near-black type, and measured hairlines.
One unframed product example instead of decorative imagery.
A split first viewport that becomes a quiet reading column on mobile.
dos: Do preserve a readable product example and explicit mode distinction.
Do keep mobile copy in normal flow with no horizontal scrolling.
donts: Don't imply that observation blocks or asks approval.
Don't add a decorative illustration, card grid, or faux inspector panel to this marketing surface.
